data.name: 1 day poison in world
data.detailed_description:
1 DAY

1 Day Poison in World is a single-player first-person 3D survival adventure set in a low-poly world affected by deadly poison. You have one in-game day to escape before the timer reaches zero.

The game is level-based. Each level begins in an open environment with city streets, buildings, roads, trees, and outdoor areas. You explore on foot in first person, look around with the mouse, jump over obstacles, and search for the route that leads toward the exit.

At the start of each level, the route to the exit is blocked. To continue, the player must explore the area and find a pressure plate. Stepping on the pressure plate opens the blocked path and allows the player to move toward the next area and the exit.

A countdown timer runs during the entire level. Exploring can help the player find the pressure plate and safer routes, but every detour uses valuable time. The player must decide when to explore carefully and when to move quickly toward the objective.

The player has a health bar and a poison meter. Poison gas fills the poison meter while the player remains in contaminated areas. Staying in poison for too long damages health. Acid, spikes, environmental obstacles, and enemies can also damage the player. Enemies can notice and chase the player in some parts of the level.

The player loses when health reaches zero or when the countdown timer reaches zero.

To complete a level, the player must find the pressure plate, unlock the blocked route, survive the hazards, and reach the exit before time runs out. Completing a level returns the player to the main menu.

A short tutorial at the beginning explains movement, hazards, pressure plates, and the level objective.

There is no long story campaign or character-level system. Progress comes from learning the level layout, understanding the dangers, finding the correct route, and improving decisions during later attempts.

A direct completion takes around 10 minutes. Exploring the available areas and searching for safer routes can take around 20 minutes.

1 Day Poison in World is a compact first-person survival adventure focused on exploration, time pressure, poison hazards, enemies, and reaching the exit.
